## 席位核对

ACCEPT · head `beac4b23497e9adaffcbab6946f6851de1343a78` · 2026-11-01T01:35Z

1. **形态:** 13 files, +494/−24; `Part of #27520` (rows 9 and 14); 0 governed paths (`check-governed-merges --pr 28495`: NOT governed), under 3000 lines. Draft, base `main`, `mergeable_state` clean.
2. **前提实测:** card rows 9 and 14, claim 6551078995 with amendments 6551260221 and 6551291021 (surface: showcase page/actions/translations, then `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`). Seat read the hand-written diff: `task-detail.page.ts` quick_actions bar names `showcase_recalc_estimate` alone; Mark Done / Log Time / Archive drop `record_section`, Recalculate Estimate declares `record_section` only, so no action is drawn by both header and bar and all six record locations keep a stock host on `showcase_task`; `ArchiveTaskAction.disabledReason` uses the existing `ActionSchema.disabledReason` door plus the zh copy key; `DetailSection` passes `alwaysShowYear` at its one date call site (grid cells unchanged); `RECORD_PAGE_APPEND_INSET` is the `page` renderer's `px-3 md:px-4 lg:px-6`; the feed body takes `text-foreground`, the meta line stays muted. Dev's live before/after at `main` `9b4d1933` in the PR body.
3. **门禁 check-runs:** 60 on the head, 52 success + 8 skipped, 0 failing; `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` success. Dev: new tests in plugin-detail, app-shell and the showcase, five ablations red then restored (blob == HEAD), 60/60 derived gates including `check:platform-checklist`.
4. **契约复审:** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` — none of the four contract faces is touched (no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed path, no widening or narrowing declaration); no record owed. `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell` matches `none` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3). Deviation accepted: beyond amendment 2's `fixtures.requires` and note text, the dev re-pointed the item's `record_section` variant line and bumped the area revision 17 → 18 with a history entry, because `check:platform-checklist` requires the bump on a semantic edit; same file, same item.
5. **范围外去向:** none filed. `task.view.ts`'s stale `record_more` comment and `showcase_zoo_disabled_gate` without a `disabledReason` are noted in Acceptance notes and left as they are (outside rows 9/14).
6. **落地条款:** seat runs `pr_ready` and arms auto-merge on the maintainer's go in this seat's thread, 2026-10-31T23:00Z 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能审核pr后落地」.
